findings.title: Insecure duck-typing check via hasattr on proxied objects
findings.description: The `has_read` function uses `hasattr(obj, "read")`, which triggers `__getattr__` on proxy objects. This introduces a security risk known as **Deserialization/Attribute Access Vulnerability** or **Insecure Proxy Handling**. In a web context, if an attacker can control the object passed to this function (e.g., via deserialization of user-supplied data that creates a malicious proxy object), they can trigger arbitrary attribute access or method invocation. More critically, `hasattr` on a malicious object that defines `__getattr__` to return a callable `read` method could allow the execution of arbitrary code if that `read` method is later invoked by the library, or expose internal state. Furthermore, `hasattr` can raise exceptions from `__getattr__` that are not properly handled, potentially leading to Denial of Service.
